subject: Important Update: New Payment Methods Added
body: Dear valued customer, we are excited to inform you that we have added new payment methods to make your shopping experience more convenient. You can now use Apple Pay, Google Pay, and PayPal for all your purchases on our website. We hope this enhancement will make it easier for you to complete transactions seamlessly. If you have any questions or need assistance, please feel free to reach out to our customer support team. Thank you for choosing us for your shopping needs.
